label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP Referer header flows directly into printf formatting without proper HTML entity encoding or context-aware sanitization. The parameter is decoded and passed through doSomething(), then used in a format string via printf which allows script injection if the content contains <script> tags or similar payloads.

evidence.note: Data flow from getHeaders -> nextElement -> decode -> doSomething -> printf demonstrates unescaped user input reaching XSS sink
